capabilities: Play sounds from a folder-based library
Loop, fade and set volume per sound
Run folder-based and JSON playlists sequentially
Trigger sounds and playlists from note buttons
Stop all playing audio at once
extras: Tutorial videos and further material are on a separate example page. Large files can use HTMLAudioElement playback above a configurable size threshold, and an iPad/iPhone compatibility mode keeps audio playing when the screen turns off.
problem: Running session audio for a TTRPG means switching to an external player, with no way to trigger sounds, ambience or playlists from inside notes.
summary: Folder-based soundboard that plays music, ambience and sound effects in Obsidian, with per-sound loop, volume, fades and playlists.
